label: tohaie
title: とはいえ
meaning: Although it is said that, even though it is said, admitting that, that being said, however, nevertheless 「A とはいえ B」は「Aは事実だが、しかし実際はB」の意味
meaning_example: Even admitting that Jane didn't have much time, I don't believe that she couldn't write a simple report like this

notes.text:
Same as といっても but:

といっても is for spoken clauses, and

とはいえ is for written clauses.



way of use: P1 とはいえ P2.

P1 is the sentence in question, P2 is the reason why.

examples.japanese: 相手に言い分もわかったとはいえ、心から納得したわけではない
examples.body_text:
相手に言い分もわかったとはいえ、心から納得したわけではない 

Admitting 
		where he's coming from, I still can't really agree with him
examples.body_html:
相手に言い分もわかったとはいえ、心から納得したわけではない 
Admitting where he's coming from, I still can't really agree with him

examples.japanese: 春になったとはいえ朝晩はまだ寒い。
examples.body_text:
春になったとはいえ朝晩はまだ寒い。 

They say that 
		Spring has arrived but the mornings and evenings are still cold.
examples.body_html:
春になったとはいえ朝晩はまだ寒い。 
They say that Spring has arrived but the mornings and evenings are still cold.

examples.japanese: 幼いとは言え、その子は自分の家庭の苦しい事情を理解している。
examples.body_text:
幼いとは言え、その子は自分の家庭の苦しい事情を理解している。 

		Even though the kid is young, 
		nevertheless 
		he understands the difficult circumstances of his family.
examples.body_html:
幼いとは言え、その子は自分の家庭の苦しい事情を理解している。 
Even though the kid is young, nevertheless he understands the difficult circumstances of his family.

examples.japanese: 便利とはいえパソコンは高いのでなかなか買えない。
examples.body_text:
便利とはいえパソコンは高いのでなかなか買えない。 

		They're useful... 
		but having said that, 
		computers are so expensive that I can't buy one.
examples.body_html:
便利とはいえパソコンは高いのでなかなか買えない。 
They're useful... but having said that, computers are so expensive that I can't buy one.

examples.japanese: ８０才の祖母は、この間階段で転んで足を痛め、歩くのが不自由になってしまった。とはいえ、全く歩けないということではないので、家事をするには問題ないとのことだ。
examples.body_text:
８０才の祖母は、この間階段で転んで足を痛め、歩くのが不自由になってしまった。とはいえ、全く歩けないということではないので、家事をするには問題ないとのことだ。 

		Recently, my 80 year old grandmother fell on the stairs and hurt her leg, and now she has trouble walking. 
		Having said that, 
		  it's not as if she cannot walk at all, in other words she can manage to do the housework without problems.
examples.body_html:
８０才の祖母は、この間階段で転んで足を痛め、歩くのが不自由になってしまった。とはいえ、全く歩けないということではないので、家事をするには問題ないとのことだ。 
Recently, my 80 year old grandmother fell on the stairs and hurt her leg, and now she has trouble walking. Having said that, it's not as if she cannot walk at all, in other words she can manage to do the housework without problems.

examples.japanese: 時間がなかったとは言え、ジェーンにこれくらいのレポートが書けないはずはない。
examples.body_text:
時間がなかったとは言え、ジェーンにこれくらいのレポートが書けないはずはない。 

Even admitting that 
		Jane didn't have much time, I don't believe that she couldn't write a simple report like this
examples.body_html:
時間がなかったとは言え、ジェーンにこれくらいのレポートが書けないはずはない。 
Even admitting that Jane didn't have much time, I don't believe that she couldn't write a simple report like this

examples.japanese: いかに暫定的処置とは言え、これはずさんすぎる
examples.body_text:
いかに暫定的処置とは言え、これはずさんすぎる 

		However much 
		they call it 
		"temporary measures", this is just too slipshod.
examples.body_html:
いかに暫定的処置とは言え、これはずさんすぎる 
However much they call it "temporary measures", this is just too slipshod.

examples.japanese: 地球温暖化を防止するための国際会議の結果、京都議定書が作成された。とはいえすべての国がその基準を守るまでには、まだ年月がかかりそうだ。
examples.body_text:
地球温暖化を防止するための国際会議の結果、京都議定書が作成された。とはいえすべての国がその基準を守るまでには、まだ年月がかかりそうだ。 

		The international conference to stop climate change ended in the creation of the Kyoto Protocol. 
		Having said that, 
		it seems like it will take a long time before every country abides by the standards it set out.
examples.body_html:
地球温暖化を防止するための国際会議の結果、京都議定書が作成された。とはいえすべての国がその基準を守るまでには、まだ年月がかかりそうだ。 
The international conference to stop climate change ended in the creation of the Kyoto Protocol. Having said that, it seems like it will take a long time before every country abides by the standards it set out.

examples.japanese: 今度の学会が楽しみだ。とは言え、まだ発表準備は全然できていない。
examples.body_text:
今度の学会が楽しみだ。とは言え、まだ発表準備は全然できていない。 

		I'm looking forward to the next academic conference. 
		That being said, 
		I haven't prepared for my presentation at all.
examples.body_html:
今度の学会が楽しみだ。とは言え、まだ発表準備は全然できていない。 
I'm looking forward to the next academic conference. That being said, I haven't prepared for my presentation at all.
